prior_visibility: D069-D076 results and local science product headers are known, including the 30 WLC raw filenames listed in ESO PRO REC1 WLC RAW1..6 NAME across the 5 November 2019 epochs (ThArNe0121, ThArNe0326, ThArNe0396, ThArNe0539, ThArNe0857) and the order/mask/direction sensitivity up to 1.45 km/s (order-merged) and 0.95 km/s (forward-reverse) at D002-0061. Zero archive queries on the 30 WLC raw observations have been executed before this lock. This is a prospective metadata and provenance gate, not a blind signal detection test.

scope.selection_rule: Include all 30 exact WLC raw references declared by the 5 existing science calibration chains without filtering, substitution, or quality-based cherry-picking.

acquisition_protocol.literal_colon_rule: Pass literal colons in <dp_id> for ESO hdr and datalink URLs; never percent-encode colons in hdr queries.
acquisition_protocol.retry_policy: At most 1 identical retry after 2.0 s sleep on HTTP 5xx, URLError, or socket timeout; retain all attempts and failures without substitution.
query_descriptions: tap_dbo_raw_wlc30.xml: exact IN-list query on dbo.raw for all 30 declared WLC dp_id values.
tap_dbo_raw_sci5.xml: exact IN-list query on dbo.raw for the 5 fixed science raw dp_id values for schema-identical metadata comparison.

tap_obscore_cal_check.xml: exact check in ivoa.ObsCore for the 5 fixed science ADP product IDs (positive query control), the 30 WLC dp_id values, and any ObsCore records referencing ThArNe0121/0326/0396/0539/0857.
30 WLC primary headers via https://archive.eso.org/hdr?<wlc_dp_id> and 30 WLC DataLink VOTables via https://archive.eso.org/datalink/links?ID=ivo://eso.org/ID?<wlc_dp_id>.

5 fixed science raw headers via https://archive.eso.org/hdr?<sci_dp_id> and 5 fixed science DataLink VOTables via https://archive.eso.org/datalink/links?ID=ivo://eso.org/ID?<sci_dp_id> to compare raw instrument/detector/fiber/lamp cards directly and inspect archive-exposed calibration links.

parsing_and_provenance_rules.hdr_parser_rule:
Extract 
...
text from ESO hdr response, html.unescape, split lines, and parse every FITS card from SIMPLE/XTENSION through END. Right-pad lines shorter than 80 chars with spaces. If a line exceeds 80 chars, check whether the assigned value finishes within columns 1..80 and only the slash comment extends past column 80 (known ESO hdr ORIGFILE display comment extension); log extended_comment_lines explicitly and flag any non-comment >80-char line as a representation anomaly without silent truncation.
parsing_and_provenance_rules.identity_rule: Verify exact match between declared raw filename, dp_id, dbo.raw.dp_id, header ARCFILE (when present), ORIGFILE, and DataLink #this semantics. Compare header DATE-OBS timestamp against dp_id timestamp and log millisecond differences explicitly.
parsing_and_provenance_rules.timescale_rule: Record DATE-OBS, MJD-OBS, EXPTIME, TPL START, and OBS START. Check whether TIMESYS is explicitly present. Where TIMESYS is absent, record TIMESYS_status="MISSING_NOT_ASSUMED_PROVEN" and compute DATE-OBS vs MJD-OBS agreement only as an explicit conditional UTC check. Compute time offset (hours and seconds) between each WLC raw MJD-OBS and its linked science raw/SDP MJD-OBS.
parsing_and_provenance_rules.configuration_and_illumination_rule: Extract INSTRUME, DPR CATG/TYPE/TECH, INS MODE, TPL ID/NAME/NEXP/EXPNO, OBS ID/NAME/PROG ID, detector chip/window/binning/readout/gain/RON keywords, and all ESO INS path/lamp/fiber/mirror/slit/shutter keywords. Compare every WLC exposure against the 5 fixed science raw headers. Retain any absent lamp or illumination keyword as MISSING_UNKNOWN; never impute missing lamp status or power as OFF or zero. Header labels document nominal command/configuration metadata, not direct physical proof of photon illumination.
parsing_and_provenance_rules.units_and_qc_rule: Record units from header comments and VOTable FIELD metadata where explicitly supplied, and keep missing units explicit (including ESO PRO REC1 WLC QC scalars). Never treat WLC QC line counts or residuals as physical RV precision, stellar RV, noise covariance, or laser response.
parsing_and_provenance_rules.access_and_region_provenance_rule: Classify public vs restricted archive access from dbo.raw release_date and DataLink #this/#calibration/#progenitor/#auxiliary rows without downloading FITS bodies. Map calibration lineage and coordinate-frame rules across D002-0061 (6550.095 A, HDU 29/30), D002-0063 (4826.6475 A, HDU 17), and D002-0071 (5730.715 A, HDU 24/25): barycentric air product coordinates, single already-applied BARYCORR (no double correction), unused simultaneous OBJECT,WAVE fiber 2 in automatic fern/1.0, absence of supplied stellar RV, and exact availability/gaps of raw WLC frames vs master ThArNe solutions and line lists.
parsing_and_provenance_rules.audit_rule: Independent stdlib-only audit.py verifies lock-before-response ordering, all locked input SHA-256 digests, all 73 raw response SHA-256 digests, an independent regex/slice FITS card parser across all 35 raw headers, an independent XML parser across all VOTables, and 50-digit Decimal/datetime arithmetic on all conditional UTC checks, exposure intervals, and WLC-to-science lead times.
